accessorials.label: protected handling
accessorials.quote: Consignments booked as fragile are handled under the Carrier's protected-handling process at ₹150.00 per consignment, in addition to freight.

components.label: freight
components.quote: consignments under 50 kg: ₹9.50 per kg of chargeable weight ... consignments over 50 kg: ₹8.25 per kg of chargeable weight

invoice_discounts.quote: In any calendar month in which the Customer tenders more than 12 consignments, the Carrier will apply a 5% discount to the invoice total for that month's invoice.

non_pricing.summary: The Carrier invoices monthly; payment is due 30 days from invoice date.
Rate revisions require 60 days' written notice and take effect from the first day of the following calendar month.

other_accessorials.quote: Freight is charged on chargeable weight

service_levels.quote: All bookings travel on standard service. Express products are not offered under this agreement.

accessorials.label: Residential delivery
accessorials.quote: Residential delivery (consignee address is a residence, or the booking is flagged residential): ₹250.00 flat per consignment.

credit_notes.quote: The Carrier may issue credit notes correcting earlier invoices. A credit note references the original consignment note number and states the invoice it corrects.

dispute_window.quote: Billing disputes must be raised within 45 days of invoice date. Disputed line items are payable only on resolution; undisputed items remain due.

components.label: Base freight per km by billed weight
components.quote: Base freight is charged per kilometre of the booked lane distance, according to the consignment's billed weight: - up to and including 500 kg: ₹18.00 per km - 501 kg to 2,000 kg: ₹24.00 per km

non_pricing.summary: Invoicing is fortnightly and payment is due 30 days from invoice date; timing terms with no effect on price calculation.

other_accessorials.quote: No other accessorial charges are payable under this agreement. Any service outside this schedule requires the Customer's written agreement in advance, evidenced by a rate confirmation referencing this agreement.

service_levels.quote: Express service, where booked, carries a premium of 15% of the base freight.

surcharges.label: Express service premium
surcharges.quote: Express service, where booked, carries a premium of 15% of the base freight.

surcharges.label: Fuel surcharge
surcharges.quote: A fuel surcharge of 12% applies to the freight charge (base freight plus express premium, where applicable).

credit_notes.quote: The Carrier may issue credit notes correcting earlier invoices. A credit note references the original c-note number and the invoice it corrects, and must cover the full corrected amount.

components.label: Weight component
components.quote: a weight component of ₹6.00 per kg of billed weight

components.label: Distance component
components.quote: a distance component of ₹2.00 per km of the booked lane distance

non_pricing.summary: Carrier invoices as trips are pooled, typically fortnightly; payment is due 21 days from invoice date.

surcharges.label: Cold chain premium
surcharges.quote: Consignments booked as cold chain travel in refrigerated vehicles and carry a premium of 20% on the freight charge (the sum of the weight and distance components).

unmatched_lines.quote: Lines that cannot be matched to a booking are not payable until reconciled.
